ana_cs: Helix onboarding: hitting sporadic 401 then cascade 429s during SDK init when using company SSO proxy. Demo in 48h. Can eng/devex triage?
vik_dev: Repro: Android SDK init -> /v1/init -> 401, client retries immediately -> 429. Only via corp proxy. Logs: 401 invalid_token then 429 within same second.
ryan_eng: likely proxy header rewrite or duplicate Authorization header. Can you paste sanitized headers?
vik_dev: sanitized: Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
User-Agent: HelixApp/2.0
X-SSO-Proxy: yes
nora_devex: two Auth headers = immediate suspect. Our server validates first header only; if proxy appends or re-inserts the token inconsistently clients get 401 then retry flood. Quick mitigation: client should collapse multiple auth headers and add jitter to retries.
vik_dev: can flip SSO passthrough off for 10m to test.
ryan_eng: eng fix idea: try validating subsequent Authorization headers if first fails, and add audit log when multiples seen. Low risk behind feature flag. I'll prepare a canary.
nana_cs: tagging AM — potential renewal risk if demo blocked.
ops-bot: incident created: CS-2076-sso-auth-dupe (prio: medium) assigned ryan_eng.
vik_dev: toggled passthrough off and ran 50 devices: 401s dropped to near-zero. Pushing client header-normalize hotfix now.
ryan_eng: PR opened with flag + audit: r/infra/501. Will canary tonight.
nora_devex: client snippet (Android): if (headers.size("Authorization")>1) { headers.set("Authorization", headers.get("Authorization").getLast()); } add exponential backoff on 401s (100ms -> 300ms -> 800ms).
vik_dev: hotfix deployed to beta, init success across 120 devices. Will monitor for 2h then confirm.
nana_cs: great work. schedule follow-up with customer and AM after monitoring window.
ops-bot: incident CS-2076 updated: monitoring.
vik_dev: 2h stable. closing incident after customer confirmation.
ops-bot: incident CS-2076 resolved at 2026-03-22T14:12:15Z
